description: This file defines the 'Delimiter' class used by PHPSpreadsheet to analyze and infer the delimiter character in CSV files during the import process.

classes.name: Delimiter
classes.description: A class responsible for analyzing lines of a CSV file to determine the most likely delimiter character used in the file.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an instance with a file handle, escape character, and enclosure character, and begins counting potential delimiters in the file.

methods.name: linesCounted
methods.description: Returns the number of lines processed for delimiter inference.

methods.name: countPotentialDelimiters
methods.description: Reads lines from the file to count the occurrence of potential delimiters.

methods.name: countDelimiterValues
methods.description: Counts how often each potential delimiter appears in a given line.

methods.name: infer
methods.description: Calculates and determines the most probable delimiter based on line counts.

methods.name: getNextLine
methods.description: Reads the next full line from the file, handling enclosures and escape characters.
